items.title: Sports billionaires are having a rough week on Wall Street
items.summary: Sports billionaires are taking center stage on Wall Street, with Dodgers owner Mark Walter facing scrutiny over his broader business empire and Carvana (CVNA) investment, while Phoenix Suns owner Mat Ishbia deals with mounting pressure at United Wholesale Mortgage (UWMC). Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi welcomes EMJ Capital founder and president Eric Jackson, Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre and Senior Business Reporter to break down the trouble surrounding both stocks and what it means for the billionaire owners behind them.

items.title: Carvana Stock Pops as Mark Walter Share Sale Concerns Fade
items.summary: Carvana shares rally as filings ease concerns tied to Mark Walter’s ownership stake. CVNA looks poised for further gains in the back half of 2026.

items.title: Carvana stock drops 10% amid Mark Walter federal investigation
items.summary: Investors are worried Mark Walter may be forced to liquidate his stake in the online used-car retailer as prosecutors and the SEC scrutinize his financial empire

items.title: Why Are Nasdaq, S&P 500 Futures Rising Premarket? NVDA, MU, SNDK, SKHY, CVNA Stocks In Focus
items.summary: Retail sentiment on Stocktwits saw some signs of deterioration, turning ‘neutral’ on SPY and ‘bearish’ on QQQ.

items.title: CVNA Stock Heads For Worst Week Since February As Mark Walter Liquidity Concerns Grow — Eric Jackson Flags $7.6B In Commitments
items.summary: Investors weigh Mark Walter’s potential $7.6 billion commitments, a federal investigation, and a $2 billion Carvana stake.

items.title: CVNA Stock Drops Amid Worries Investor Mark Walter May Unload $2B Stake
items.summary: Walter, one of Carvana’s largest investors, holds roughly 30 million shares, or about a 4% stake worth around $2 billion, according to Bloomberg.

items.title: Carvana Stock Falls Amid Concerns About Walter Probe
items.summary: Shares of Carvana dropped 7.3% Tuesday as worries swirl that a federal investigation into one of its investors, Mark Walter, could lead to the billionaire selling his stake of the used car retailer. After falling yesterday, Carvana shares are now down about 13% this week.

items.title: 3 Big Reasons to Love Carvana (CVNA)
items.summary: Since February 2026, Carvana has been in a holding pattern, posting a small loss of 3% while floating around $70.14. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500’s 13.1% gain during that period.
